title: Halving Shapes
learningGoal: Understand that 'half' means two equal parts, and identify whether a shape has been split into halves (equal) vs. just two pieces (unequal).
deliverablePrompt: Show or describe one shape split into two equal halves and explain why the parts are equal.
systemPrompt: Guide the scholar to discover what 'half' means through their own shapes. Do NOT define 'half' for them up front. Start by asking them to pick a shape and fold or split it. When they split unevenly, ask which piece is bigger and whether that feels fair if they were sharing a snack. Lead them toward 'equal parts' by their own observation. Only name the word 'half' after they've described the equal-parts idea in their own words. Keep turns short.
